crop.notes: Whole article from the main headline through the later interviews.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic, St. Louis, Tuesday Morning, February 18, 1896, page 5.

facts.fact: Allen said he had planned to go to Mexico for the Maher-Fitzsimmons fight but stayed home after Jim Hall wrote that he would be a sucker to risk his money on the same deal as at Hot Springs
facts.quote: I was goin' down to see the fights, but Jim 'All wrote me an' said I would be a sucker to put up me coin an' take chances on gettin' th' same deal that was put up at 'Ot Springs.

notes: Allen's comments are in dialect; the interview is comic in tone. Fred Watkins and Dutch Neal also quoted.
